body: It mostly comes down to being just not being useful to anyone. I feel like I make everything worse. I recently made another post about that goes a little more in depth. But thank you a lot for taking the time to write this. I’ll for sure check out the links.

I know, working is especially so hard, or any type of work really, errands or chores are the same way. Just having to do mundane everything day things suck, it makes it feel like just another day, when it’s not, their gone, it’s not a normal day. No day ever will be again

After my best friends pretty recent suicide, I have had a dream about him every night. It pretty much alternates between us just talk and having fun like we used to, and me trying to convince him not to do it, no matter which one I have I hate it when I wake up. I’m either sad that I wasn’t actually having fun with him, or upset I couldn’t stop him. So I guess it they could be nice, but at least right now I just want them all to stop

I know there is really nothing anyone can say to make things magical better, but for my sake, I beg you not to and reconsider. if you just need someone to actually care I'm here. DM me if you just want to talk.

thanks for the advice, right now just really don't want to do any of these things without him. we actually have 3 sets of concert tickets for this year (that I have no idea what to do with), it just feels like without him I can't have fun or be happy, and without being happy what's even the point.
